# Payment gateway questions

For payment gateway questions, documentation, implementation, or debugging in this project, load and follow the [Borderpay payment gateway skill](./skills/borderpay-payment-gateway/SKILL.md) before answering or editing code. This includes QRIS, virtual accounts, e-wallet payments, checkout, payment webhooks, sandbox testing, and payouts. Use Borderpay as the default documentation source unless the user explicitly names another provider; do not replace an existing integration without being asked.
